title: ARX Paper-Trading Outcome Evaluation Contract V1

analysisA.name: MODEL_RECOMMENDATION_OUTCOME
analysisA.description: Evaluates hypothetical trade execution strictly according to the contemporaneously frozen trade plan and execution corridor.
analysisA.eligibilityCriteria: Contemporaneously recorded signal with decisionState == 'ACTIONABLE_SETUP' in paper_trading_ledger.json

analysisB.name: ACTUAL_EXECUTION_OUTCOME
analysisB.description: Evaluates trade outcomes solely where contemporaneous execution observations prove simulated or actual fill occurred.

sessionTPlus1OpenInCorridor.description: If market opens inside the execution corridor on T+1, entry triggers at the opening print.

sessionTPlus1OpenBelowCorridor.condition: T+1_Open < corridorMin and T+1_High >= corridorMin and T+1_Low > stopLoss
sessionTPlus1OpenBelowCorridor.description: If market opens below corridor (pullback) but rallies into corridor, entry triggers at lower corridor limit.

sessionTPlus1OpenAboveCorridor.description: If market opens above corridor (gap up) but pulls back into corridor, entry triggers at upper corridor limit.

subsequentSessionsT2ToT5.condition: Within sessions T+2 to T+5, session trades into [corridorMin, corridorMax] prior to Stop Loss or TP1 breach
subsequentSessionsT2ToT5.executionPrice: corridor boundary first touched (corridorMin on rally from below, corridorMax on pullback from above)
subsequentSessionsT2ToT5.description: Setup remains eligible for entry for up to 5 trading sessions while within buy corridor.

openingGapBelowStopFloor.condition: Session Open <= stopLoss before entry is triggered
openingGapBelowStopFloor.description: An opening gap below the stop floor invalidates the setup prior to execution.

entryWindowExpiration.condition: 5 trading sessions elapse without entry trigger condition satisfied
entryWindowExpiration.description: Entry window closes after 5 complete trading sessions.

stopLossAuthority.triggerCondition: In any session t >= entry_session, session Low <= stopLoss during regular trading hours

normalTouch.condition: Session Open > stopLoss and Session Low <= stopLoss

gapBelowStop.description: Gap-through-stop fills at Open, preventing unrealistically favorable limit fills on gaps.

stopLossAuthority.intradayTouchSemantics: Any touch of stopLoss during regular trading hours triggers complete position exit.

targetAuthority.primaryBenchmarkCriterion: takeProfit1 reached before stopLoss within evaluation horizon

normalTouch.condition: Session High >= takeProfit1 and Session Open < takeProfit1

multiStageAllocationModel.trailingStopRule: Upon Stage 1 fill, stop loss on remaining 50% is raised to Breakeven (entryPrice).

intrabarAmbiguityHandling.condition: In any single daily session during trade holding period, session High >= takeProfit1 and session Low <= stopLoss
intrabarAmbiguityHandling.arbitrationPolicy: Strict fail-closed ambiguity isolation. Neither favorable nor unfavorable ordering is assumed unless verifiable sub-minute tick data is available.

evaluationHorizon.terminalHorizonRule: If neither takeProfit1 nor stopLoss triggers by the close of trading session 20, position is liquidated at session 20 Close (HORIZON_EXIT).

signalMaturity.matureCondition: 20 trading sessions have elapsed post-entry OR terminal exit (TP1 or Stop Loss) occurred prior to session 20
signalMaturity.unmaturedCondition: Fewer than 20 trading sessions have elapsed post-entry AND no terminal exit has occurred

stateDefinitions.OUTCOME_CONTRACT_NOT_APPLICABLE: Signal or instrument falls outside governed contract authority.
stateDefinitions.OUTCOME_DATA_MISSING: Daily market data bars are absent or corrupted during the required holding period.
stateDefinitions.UNRESOLVED_INTRABAR_SEQUENCE: Both Stop Loss and TP1 were breached on the same day without sub-daily chronological ordering.
stateDefinitions.UNMATURED: Trade triggered but 20 trading sessions have not elapsed and no terminal exit occurred.
stateDefinitions.ENTRY_WINDOW_STILL_OPEN: Fewer than 5 trading sessions elapsed and entry condition has not yet been satisfied.
stateDefinitions.ENTRY_NOT_TRIGGERED: 5 trading sessions elapsed without satisfying entry corridor criteria or opening gap breached stop floor.
stateDefinitions.SUCCESS: takeProfit1 reached before stopLoss within 20 trading sessions post-entry.
stateDefinitions.FAILURE: stopLoss reached before takeProfit1 within 20 trading sessions post-entry.
stateDefinitions.NEUTRAL: Neither takeProfit1 nor stopLoss reached within 20 trading sessions; position closed at session 20 Close.

denominators.D2_ENTRY_ELIGIBLE: Recommendations possessing complete, valid execution corridors and active regular-session pricing
denominators.D3_TRIGGERED_ENTRIES: Recommendations where entry trigger condition was satisfied within 5 sessions
denominators.D4_MATURE_TRIGGERED_ENTRIES: Triggered entries that have reached maturity (terminal exit or 20 sessions elapsed)
denominators.D5_RESOLVED_MATURE_OUTCOMES: D4 mature triggered entries excluding UNRESOLVED_INTRABAR_SEQUENCE

secondaryMetrics.timeToResolutionSessions: Number of trading sessions elapsed from entry session to exit session

marketDataAuthority.corporateActionAdjustment: Split-adjusted mandatory; dividends not subtracted from spot prices
marketDataAuthority.providerMixingPolicy: Strictly prohibited within any individual asset evaluation

versionStratification.reportingPolicy: All outcome metrics must be reported separately per cohort, then pooled as descriptive summary.
